extraction_policy.unit: One independently verifiable behavior, prohibition, product acceptance point, rollout dependency, or explicit phase decision per stable ID.
extraction_policy.included: All normative MVP, cross-phase, conditional-future, Phase 2 and Phase 3 requirements in the locked v0.21 source, including product, off-chain, runtime, governance, legal and residual-risk obligations.
extraction_policy.excluded: Explanatory history, comparative rationale and cost examples are not separate IDs unless they create a behavior, prohibition, trigger, decision or acceptance condition.

status_definitions.implemented_static: Current repository source and focused local evidence implement the atomic requirement; this is not deployed or production proof.
status_definitions.implemented_deviation: The behavior is implemented with a documented semantic deviation that still requires explicit product acceptance.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation or evidence exists, but the atomic acceptance point is not closed.
status_definitions.external_required: Mandatory for the product phase, but owned by another product, infrastructure, operations, legal, or vendor workstream.
status_definitions.not_implemented: No conforming implementation is present in the current repository or evidenced external system.
status_definitions.deferred: Explicitly assigned to a later phase and not required for the V1 contract release.
status_definitions.decision_required: Implementation or rollout cannot be accepted until the named product or release decision is frozen.

requirements.requirement: Treat product-framework.md v0.21 as authority; the older MVP engineering document is explicitly stale for the v0.19-v0.21 mechanism changes.
requirements.implementation: manifests/requirements.lock pins v0.21 bytes and SHA-256; this manifest uses that source only.
requirements.tests_evidence: SHA-256, byte-count and source-line validation for this manifest.
requirements.decision: Any later source revision requires a new lock, review and requirement-version update.

requirements.requirement: Deliver the product as two layers: a permissionless protocol and a flagship frontend.
requirements.implementation: Permissionless contracts and minimal integration examples exist; the flagship product does not.
requirements.tests_evidence: test/unit protocol suites; examples/react SSR tests only.
requirements.decision: Do not call the full MVP complete until both layers pass their own acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Optimize architecture for long-tail, subjective and socially distributed UGC markets instead of copying Polymarket.
requirements.implementation: Parimutuel plus sell-only C2C reflects the principle; product discovery and distribution are outside this repository.
requirements.decision: Freeze market-selection, distribution and trust UX before MVP launch.

requirements.requirement: Launch the streamer vertical with binary market UX while keeping the pool contract n-outcome capable.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault supports 2-32 outcomes; no flagship streamer/binary experience exists here.
requirements.tests_evidence: test/unit/ProtocolFlows.t.sol covers multiple outcomes; no product runtime evidence.
requirements.decision: Freeze MVP category, binary templates and user-facing outcome labels.

requirements.requirement: Do not implement an AMM.
requirements.implementation: No AMM contract, pool curve or LP role exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Contract inventory and audit scope review.
requirements.decision: AMM remains out of scope.

requirements.requirement: Do not implement a CLOB, maker program or market-maker dependency.
requirements.implementation: FixedPriceMarketplaceV1 has only escrowed seller listings and direct fills.
requirements.decision: CLOB and MM ecosystem remain out of scope.

requirements.requirement: Use one parimutuel pool with multiple outcome buckets for the primary market.
requirements.implementation: src/market/MarketVaultCoreV1.sol maintains one principal pool and per-outcome supply.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Allow primary issuance only from market open until close.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault buy paths require timestamp before closeAt.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: On void, refund exactly 1 USDC per share to the current holder and leave no dispute path.
requirements.implementation: All void reasons burn current ERC-1155 balances and refund principal 1:1. A selected outcome with zero supply enters VOIDED / NO_WINNING_SUPPLY without rake or early-bird allocation.
requirements.decision: Confirmed rebuild plan: zero winning supply voids with a distinct reason; do not select a different outcome or slash the creator bond.

requirements.requirement: Provide a fixed-price, seller-initiated C2C transfer market.
requirements.implementation: src/marketplace/FixedPriceMarketplaceV1.sol.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Allow C2C from after a position exists until market terminal state.
requirements.implementation: Registered non-terminal Vault shares may be listed and filled before terminal state.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Fund early-bird rewards from rake without changing the winner-pool formula.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault calculates a separate earlyBirdPool from creator net rake. Scores use actual filled units and exact integer thirds of createdAt to closeAt, with weights 3/2/1 and no separate earlyBirdStart.
requirements.decision: Freeze launch percentages through governance configuration.

requirements.requirement: Close markets before the underlying event starts to mitigate last-minute information advantage.
requirements.implementation: closeAt is immutable after first buy, but the protocol cannot verify external event start time.
requirements.tests_evidence: Market time-boundary tests; no external schedule/runtime proof.
requirements.decision: Templates and creator UX must validate event-start versus closeAt.

requirements.requirement: Display pool proportions as real-time implied probability or odds.
requirements.implementation: On-chain principal/supply data is available; no flagship odds UI exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Indexer and SDK data tests only; no rendered product evidence.
requirements.decision: Freeze odds convention and formatting.

requirements.requirement: Clearly state that final odds are determined at close.
requirements.implementation: Not present in the minimal React integration examples.
requirements.decision: Approve mandatory warning copy and placement.

requirements.requirement: Tokenize homogeneous outcome shares as divisible ERC-1155 units.
requirements.implementation: Each MarketVault is an ERC-1155 with one outcome ID per bucket and 1e6 units per whole share.
requirements.tests_evidence: ERC-1155 conformance, unit and transfer-integrity tests; reports/security/token-integration.md.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Represent the asset key as market multiplied by outcome tokenId semantics.
requirements.implementation: The MarketVault address is the market dimension and outcomeId is the ERC-1155 tokenId within that Vault; the canonical cross-chain and off-chain asset key is (chainId,vault,outcomeId), while on-chain chain context is implicit.
requirements.decision: Keep per-Vault ERC-1155 isolation; do not introduce a shared global ERC-1155 or encoded global tokenId.

requirements.requirement: Define one whole primary share as 1 USDC principal.
requirements.implementation: 1e6 ERC-1155 units equal one whole share; one atomic share unit costs one USDC atomic unit.
requirements.tests_evidence: SDK unit tests and primary purchase accounting tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Keep early-bird entitlement with the original buyer and do not transfer it with ERC-1155 shares.
requirements.implementation: earlyBirdScore is address-based across outcomes and unaffected by share transfer; late first purchases remain valid. Full-wallet discovery of zero-balance original buyers is still a B2 product task, not implied by this protocol status.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Support sell listings only.
requirements.implementation: Marketplace exposes createListing, fillListing and cancelListing; no bid path exists.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Escrow listed shares in the marketplace at a fixed per-share price.
requirements.implementation: createListing transfers exact ERC-1155 units into FixedPriceMarketplaceV1 and records unitPrice.
requirements.tests_evidence: Marketplace escrow receiver and listing tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Allow arbitrary share splitting and partial listing fills.
requirements.implementation: Listing amount and desired/min fill units support bounded partial fills.
requirements.tests_evidence: Marketplace partial-fill, race and rounding tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Allow unconditional seller cancellation; repricing must be cancel then relist.
requirements.implementation: cancelListing returns remaining escrow; no in-place price mutation exists.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Do not implement a matching engine, on-chain price-priority queue or order-book sorting.
requirements.implementation: Listings use seller nonces and direct IDs without an ordered on-chain book.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Exclude buyer offers from MVP and add them only if liquidity evidence triggers the follow-up.
requirements.implementation: No buyer-offer function exists.
requirements.decision: Use sustained low fill rate and concentrated urgent-sale feedback as the future trigger.

requirements.requirement: Permit C2C listings before close as an exit path.
requirements.implementation: Non-terminal shares can be listed before close.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Before close, fold listings priced above 1 USDC and warn that primary purchase is cheaper.
requirements.implementation: The Web Demo hides listings above 1 USDC before close, warns that primary purchase is cheaper, blocks stale selected high-price fills and restores freely priced listings at close; the protocol price bounds remain unchanged.
requirements.tests_evidence: examples/web-demo/test/marketplace-flow.test.tsx and examples/react/test/components.test.tsx cover the pre-close, stale-selection and close-boundary behavior; production flagship browser acceptance remains open.
requirements.decision: Use a strict greater-than-1-USDC fold threshold, keep seller cancellation available and restore eligible listings at close.

requirements.requirement: After close and before terminal state, disable primary issuance and leave freely priced C2C as the only entry path.
requirements.implementation: Primary buy closes at closeAt while marketplace remains available until terminal state.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: At terminal state, stop new listings/fills and keep unfilled escrow recoverable.
requirements.implementation: Terminal checks stop create/fill and returnTerminalListing is permissionless.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Keep pool-implied odds and C2C prices independent; C2C must not change pool proportions or payout.
requirements.implementation: Marketplace transfers existing ERC-1155 units and never mutates MarketVault principal/supply.
requirements.tests_evidence: Cross-component accounting invariants and marketplace flow tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Show pool and C2C signals together before close, C2C only after close, and C2C price in OBS after close.
requirements.implementation: Read API exists; flagship charting and OBS do not.
requirements.decision: Freeze latest-trade calculation, stale-price policy and presentation.

requirements.requirement: Expose configurable platform and creator C2C fee fields with both MVP defaults set to zero.
requirements.implementation: ProtocolConfig and market economic snapshot include both bounded fee fields and zero defaults.
requirements.decision: Freeze production defaults before deployment.

requirements.requirement: Apply user and market caps only to primary purchases, not C2C transfers.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault enforces cumulative primary caps; Marketplace has no holding cap.
requirements.decision: Accept Sybil residual risk and freeze caps.

requirements.requirement: Execute listing, fill and cancellation as user-signed on-chain transactions without platform order-server or asset-transfer signatures.
requirements.implementation: Marketplace state and actions are fully on-chain; Permit2 authorizes payment only.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Restrict sponsored C2C calls to an explicit Paymaster whitelist.
requirements.implementation: offchain/paymaster-service SponsorPolicy decodes account calls and enforces target/selector/value allowlists.
requirements.decision: Production allowlist and policy version must be frozen with deployment addresses.

requirements.requirement: Enforce per-user daily sponsored listing and cancellation count limits.
requirements.implementation: SponsorPolicy decodes account calls into create/cancel operation counts, and PostgresSponsorBudgetStore atomically reserves durable per-user daily create/cancel budgets together with gas-cost budgets.
requirements.decision: Launch uses durable PostgreSQL counters; keep fail-closed real-PostgreSQL CI and runtime-readiness gates.

requirements.requirement: Apply a minimum listed-share threshold to sponsored C2C creation.
requirements.implementation: SponsorPolicy requires exact 164-byte createListing calldata, decodes the amount word and rejects amounts below CPREDICT_PAYMASTER_MIN_SPONSORED_LISTING_UNITS before signing; configuration requires a positive uint128-bounded value and .env.example defaults to 1,000,000 units.
requirements.decision: Freeze the production minimum per market economics; the repository default is 1,000,000 units.

requirements.requirement: If free sponsorship is unavailable or over limit, fall back to USDC-paid gas so users never need gas token.
requirements.implementation: SDK defines free sponsor then external USDC Paymaster fallback; no live provider integration is configured or verified.
requirements.tests_evidence: offchain/sdk/test/aa.test.ts covers fallback and never-settling provider deadlines; no provider/runtime proof.
requirements.decision: Select provider, regions, limits and failure policy; native ETH cannot be the default product path.

requirements.requirement: Use the structured proposition form: whether X happens before Y according to Z.
requirements.implementation: offchain/sdk/src/market-rules.ts defines a canonical structured rules commitment; no flagship creation pipeline enforces adoption.
requirements.decision: Freeze template catalogue and require canonical JSON publication.

requirements.requirement: Require a resolution source in every market rule set.
requirements.implementation: marketRulesSchema requires resolutionSource and commits it through rulesHash; Vault stores source hash/URI.
requirements.tests_evidence: market-rules SDK tests and Factory/Vault validation tests.
requirements.decision: Define trusted display and URI content policy.

requirements.requirement: Require a market deadline in every structured rule set.
requirements.implementation: marketRulesSchema requires closesAt and MarketVault commits closeAt.
requirements.tests_evidence: market-rules SDK tests and time-boundary tests.
requirements.decision: Validate template event time against closeAt externally.

requirements.requirement: Require cancellation/invalid terms; sports templates default cancellation to void and refund.
requirements.implementation: marketRulesSchema requires cancellationPolicy; no flagship sports-template default exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: market-rules SDK tests prove the commitment field.
requirements.decision: Approve per-category default cancellation language.

requirements.requirement: Classify markets as live-stream, sports or private.
requirements.implementation: Generic metadata can carry category; no authoritative category service/UI exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze MVP category set and private-market access semantics.

requirements.requirement: Charge a configurable creation fee that may be set to zero.
requirements.implementation: ProtocolConfig and MarketFactory collect a bounded creation fee.
requirements.decision: Freeze launch default.

requirements.requirement: Require a refundable creator bond and slash it only for timeout abandonment.
requirements.implementation: BondEscrow returns the bond on resolution, creator void or zero-winning-supply void; only TIMEOUT with nonzero principal funds participant rewards. An empty timeout returns the bond to creator.
requirements.decision: For a zero-principal timeout, return the bond to creator because no participant or valid distribution denominator exists.

requirements.requirement: Let creator set rake within a hard cap and pay protocol share from that rake.
requirements.implementation: Market economic snapshot fixes bounded creatorRakeBps and protocolShareBps.
requirements.decision: Freeze cap and launch defaults.

requirements.requirement: Do not use pre-listing approval; use labeling and traffic tiers.
requirements.implementation: Protocol creation is permissionless; labeling and traffic systems are absent.
requirements.tests_evidence: Factory permissionless tests; no product pipeline evidence.
requirements.decision: Freeze no-approval operational policy.

requirements.requirement: Do not render redline topics involving harm, minors or privacy exposure.
requirements.implementation: No redline classifier or frontend hiding exists.
requirements.decision: Define taxonomy, model threshold, appeal and legal policy.

requirements.requirement: Show grey or low-quality topics with risk labels but do not promote them.
requirements.implementation: No labeling or traffic-ranking service exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze thresholds and label copy.

requirements.requirement: Promote high-quality topics based on labeling and creator trust.
requirements.implementation: No recommendation or promotion engine exists.
requirements.decision: Define transparent ranking inputs and auditability.

requirements.requirement: Compute a determinability score and warn when creator discretion is high.
requirements.implementation: No LLM labeling service exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze model, thresholds, versioning and fallback.

requirements.requirement: Treat resolution-evidence registration as voluntary and label missing registration.
requirements.implementation: Vault can store a resolution source, but no trust label pipeline exists.
requirements.decision: Define registered-evidence semantics without implying adjudication.

requirements.requirement: Label whether creator can influence the outcome.
requirements.implementation: No manipulability classifier or user-facing label exists.
requirements.decision: Define detection and disclosure rules.

requirements.requirement: Attach category and creator-credit information to each topic.
requirements.implementation: No creator-credit service or product view exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Indexer exposes raw market activity only.
requirements.decision: Freeze credit model and public API contract.

requirements.requirement: Re-run labels when resolution source, close time or other key topic data changes.
requirements.implementation: Market metadata events exist; no event-triggered labeling worker exists.
requirements.decision: Define triggering events, debounce and model-version history.

requirements.requirement: Build creator credit from settlement timeliness, voids, slashes, anomaly signals, feedback and experience, with public tiers that affect traffic but not protocol access.
requirements.implementation: Raw settlement and trade events are indexable; scoring, feedback and tiers are absent.
requirements.tests_evidence: Indexer API tests do not prove a scoring model.
requirements.decision: Publish formula, appeal process and privacy policy.

requirements.requirement: Expose topic labels and creator credit publicly to users, creators and other frontends through an open API.
requirements.implementation: Current API exposes markets/listings/fills/positions/claims, not labels or reputation.
requirements.tests_evidence: offchain/indexer/test/api.test.ts confirms only raw protocol read models.
requirements.decision: Define versioned public schema and SLA.

requirements.requirement: Make all permissionless markets immediately visible without pre-approval and apply labels asynchronously within seconds.
requirements.implementation: Factory creation is immediate and Indexer dynamically discovers markets; no flagship visibility or labeling latency proof exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Factory and Indexer dynamic-discovery tests only.
requirements.decision: Define redline exception, finality and provisional display policy.

requirements.requirement: Target more than 90 percent template usage; default free-text markets to low promotion with rewrite guidance.
requirements.implementation: SDK has a structured schema, but no template adoption or rewrite system exists.
requirements.decision: Define adoption metric and rewrite UX.

requirements.requirement: Provide a human appeal queue only for redline false positives and post-hoc frontend takedown/downranking, without changing chain settlement.
requirements.implementation: No moderation or appeal operations system exists; chain actions remain independent.
requirements.decision: Staff owner, SLA, audit log and no-adjudication boundary.

requirements.requirement: Allow creators to pre-register markets and activate them instantly during a stream.
requirements.implementation: No pre-registration/activation product workflow exists.
requirements.decision: Define whether pre-registration creates on-chain immediately or stores a draft off-chain.

requirements.requirement: Lock creator settlement as the default market mode before betting.
requirements.implementation: V1 exposes creator-only resolve/creatorVoid and freezes market economics after first buy.
requirements.tests_evidence: Protocol flow and exact deadline-boundary tests.
requirements.decision: V1 supports creator mode only.

requirements.requirement: After close, creator may choose an outcome or void within the deadline and terminal state takes effect immediately without proposal, challenge or arbitration.
requirements.implementation: resolve and creatorVoid transition directly and irreversibly before resolutionDeadline.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: For objective markets, support fixed-source API settlement with creator excluded, permissionless triggering and prewritten void fallbacks.
requirements.implementation: Not present in V1; requires a new market type/version.
requirements.decision: Freeze source hierarchy and failure semantics before design.

requirements.requirement: For private markets, support participant consensus and timeout void on deadlock.
requirements.implementation: Not present in V1; requires participant membership and voting semantics.
requirements.decision: Define invitation, quorum, transfer and Sybil semantics.

requirements.requirement: After settlement timeout, let anyone trigger void and refund current holders mechanically.
requirements.implementation: voidAfterDeadline is permissionless at now >= resolutionDeadline.
requirements.tests_evidence: Exact boundary, refund and invariant tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Limit creator power to choosing result/void; creator must not alter payout formula or withdraw pool principal.
requirements.implementation: Creator has no principal sweep or economic mutation path after first buy.
requirements.tests_evidence: Privilege review, ABI review and invariants.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Use deadline, primary caps and timeout bond slash as the only mechanical creator-abuse mitigations.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault caps/deadline and BondEscrow implement these controls.
requirements.decision: Freeze caps and bond policy.

requirements.requirement: Distribute a timeout-slashed bond to participants with void refunds rather than protocol revenue.
requirements.implementation: With nonzero principal, the full bond follows refund units; with zero principal, there is no participant or valid denominator, so the bond credits creator instead of entering an unclaimable pool.
requirements.decision: Product decision frozen on 2026-09-02: zero-principal timeout returns the bond to creator; all participant markets distribute the full bond by refund units.

requirements.requirement: Before betting, prominently warn that creator settles unilaterally and the protocol/platform does not adjudicate; expose creator profile in one action.
requirements.implementation: Minimal React lifecycle panel has a warning, but no flagship placement, profile or browser evidence exists.
requirements.decision: Approve mandatory copy, placement and non-dismissible behavior.

requirements.requirement: Mitigate but explicitly disclose single-betrayal risk using caps, tiered exposure and reputation.
requirements.implementation: Caps exist; tiered exposure, reputation and product disclosure are absent.
requirements.decision: Freeze maximum exposure and risk copy.

requirements.requirement: Allow creator to attach an optional evidence link at settlement and show it with the settlement record.
requirements.implementation: resolve and creatorVoid accept an optional bytes32 evidenceHash and terminal events expose it; the SDK defines canonical JSON bytes, SHA-256, CIDv1 raw and derived IPFS URI, while the Indexer persists and reconstructs the record for API and React consumers.
requirements.tests_evidence: test/unit/MarketVaultEdges.t.sol; offchain/sdk/test/evidence.test.ts; offchain/indexer/test/indexer.test.ts; offchain/indexer/test/postgres.integration.test.ts; offchain/indexer/test/api.test.ts; examples/react/test/components.test.tsx; reports/postgresql-integration.md.
requirements.decision: Zero hash means no evidence; the hash is an opaque non-adjudicative commitment and canonical bytes must be uploaded verbatim.

requirements.requirement: Do not build recording, snapshot, evidence registry, UMA, challenge bond, insurance fund or result-arbitration infrastructure.
requirements.implementation: No such contracts/services exist; evidence is non-adjudicative.
requirements.decision: Keep excluded systems out of V1 scope.

requirements.requirement: Implement multi-outcome events as one pool with n buckets, not multiple binary pools or CTF/negRisk linkage.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault holds 2-32 outcomes in one principal pool.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Audit the pool and C2C marketplace together for at least one to two independent rounds.
requirements.implementation: Internal review/RFP material exists; no independent audit engagement or remediation report exists.
requirements.decision: Two independent audits and re-reviews are release blockers.

requirements.requirement: Mint ERC-1155 on primary buy, burn on claim/refund, pay current holders, and keep early-bird claim separate for original buyers.
requirements.implementation: MarketVault implements separate ERC-1155, winner/refund and early-bird accounting paths.
requirements.tests_evidence: Protocol flows, token integrity and invariants.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Make C2C fill atomic: buyer USDC and seller shares exchange in the same transaction.
requirements.implementation: FixedPriceMarketplaceV1 payment and ERC-1155 transfer are nonReentrant and revert atomically.
requirements.tests_evidence: Marketplace payment, receiver and malicious-token tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Provide a batch-oriented micro-pool settlement design so gas does not consume small-pool rake.
requirements.implementation: Settlement is O(1), claims are permissionless, smart accounts may batch 1-32 calls, and deterministic BigInt models cover Full/Clone settlement, void, AA batching, sponsorship budgets and break-even sensitivity. A fail-closed seven-gate commercial evaluator now covers bond deterrence, micro-pool funding coverage, caps, early-bird Sybil, C2C liquidity, LaunchGuard retirement and extreme-gas exits without changing Solidity. Its approved policy selects GROSS_RAKE, PROTOCOL_FEE or CREATOR_NET_AFTER_EARLY_BIRD plus a committed funding share instead of assuming all rake is available; Arbitrum receipts, approved thresholds and independent business evidence remain open.
requirements.tests_evidence: Production gas gates PASS in reports/gas-and-size.md; scripts/economics/unit-economics.test.mjs, scripts/economics/commercial-economics.test.mjs, reports/economics/micro-pool-unit-economics.md, reports/economics/micro-pool-unit-economics.json and reports/economics/commercial-economics-gate.md provide reproducible model evidence. The commercial report is 7/7 NOT_VERIFIED; resolve/void finalize gas, exact source/audit/deployment address/codehash binding, provenance ending no later than assessment time, live fee and ETH/USD evidence and production mass-claim validation remain unverified.
requirements.decision: Define acceptable pool size, gas subsidy and batch claim/worker strategy.

requirements.requirement: Deploy on a selected low-fee L2 and denominate in canonical USDC.
requirements.implementation: Arbitrum Sepolia deployment scripts and canonical-token checks exist; no live deployment or final mainnet selection exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Local scripts only; no address/transaction manifest.
requirements.decision: Freeze chain, USDC address/proxy risk, finality and codehash.

requirements.requirement: Keep user principal only in its MarketVault, creator bond only in BondEscrow and protocol fees only in FeeVault.
requirements.implementation: Per-market Vault, BondEscrow and FeeVault are separated.
requirements.tests_evidence: Accounting invariants, token integration and flow tests.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Marketplace may escrow shares but must not retain USDC balances; fills transfer payment atomically.
requirements.implementation: Marketplace transfers seller proceeds and fee amounts during fill and has no user-USDC withdrawal pool.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Return creator bond at non-timeout terminal states, slash only on timeout, and never count slashed bond as protocol revenue.
requirements.implementation: BondEscrow credits creator on resolve/creator void, funds participant bonus on timeout with principal, and returns the bond on zero-principal timeout.
requirements.tests_evidence: Bond lifecycle and timeout bonus tests.
requirements.decision: The zero-principal exception is frozen by PF-SETTLE-008 and never routes funds to protocol revenue.

requirements.requirement: Keep asset paths non-upgradeable and expose no admin function that can withdraw user principal.
requirements.implementation: Vault/Marketplace/Bond/Fee asset paths are immutable V1 contracts without principal sweep.
requirements.tests_evidence: Manual privilege review, ABI inventory and invariants.
requirements.decision: Clone implementation remains fixed and requires separate risk acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Restrict multisig to bounded parameters behind timelock and use a higher threshold for membership changes.
requirements.implementation: Config bounds and deployment Timelock/Safe scripts exist; real Safe membership and roles are not deployed or verified.
requirements.tests_evidence: Protocol control tests; no chain role evidence.
requirements.decision: Freeze 4/6 governance, 2/6 emergency, 7-day mainnet timelock and rotation plan.

requirements.requirement: Emergency pause must stop only new risk, expire automatically, and never stop cancel, claim or refund.
requirements.implementation: EmergencyController has bounded epochs and may pause listing fills because a fill creates new buyer exposure; cancel, terminal return, claim, refund and direct ERC-1155 transfer remain available.
requirements.decision: Product decision frozen on 2026-09-02: keep PAUSE_LISTING_FILL for contract-security incidents while preserving unconditional asset-return exits.

requirements.requirement: Prove solvency, payout/refund conservation, share mint/burn conservation and atomic C2C through invariants, fuzzing and audits.
requirements.implementation: Foundry invariants, coverage and Medusa passed; bounded Halmos and SMTChecker passed; Echidna arm64 passed 1,000,053 calls, while x86_64 lifecycle, whole-protocol mutation and external audits remain open.
requirements.decision: All defined gates must pass before release candidate.

requirements.requirement: Keep timeout, bond settlement, guard sync and other automation permissionless with no privileged keeper.
requirements.implementation: Relevant public functions are permissionless; worker uses no privileged protocol role.
requirements.decision: Worker signer must hold only gas and no special role.

requirements.requirement: Make listing cancellation unconditional regardless of pause or market state.
requirements.implementation: cancelListing has no pause/terminal modifier; terminal return is also permissionless.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Accrue platform and creator C2C fees for pull-based beneficiary claims so fill does not depend on beneficiary callbacks.
requirements.implementation: Fill transfers fees to fixed FeeVault and accrues beneficiary credits; beneficiaries claim separately.
requirements.decision: None.

requirements.requirement: Verify deployed bytecode, dependency fingerprints, roles and source reproducibility before accepting the permission model.
requirements.implementation: Factory activation fingerprint and deployment/source-manifest tooling exist; no Arbitrum Sepolia or production-mainnet runtime verification exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Factory validation tests; deployment status remains unverified.
requirements.decision: Complete Arbitrum Sepolia then mainnet address/codehash/role manifests.

requirements.requirement: Provide an embedded non-custodial wallet without seed-phrase/private-key mental overhead.
requirements.implementation: No wallet vendor integration exists; examples require an injected client.
requirements.decision: Select vendor, recovery, export and regional policy.

requirements.requirement: Provide gasless user actions throughout the core loop.
requirements.implementation: Paymaster contract/service and SDK lanes exist; no production signer, bundler, deposit or provider runtime exists.
requirements.decision: Fund budgets, select provider and define fallback/SLA.

requirements.requirement: Provide fiat and USDC funding paths.
requirements.implementation: Protocol accepts USDC; no deposit product or provider integration exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze launch countries and provider tier.

requirements.requirement: Provide position and C2C listing management.
requirements.implementation: Indexer read API and transaction examples exist; no complete account dashboard exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Indexer/API and React SSR tests only.
requirements.decision: Define pending/finality/reorg states and pagination UX.

requirements.requirement: Provide user notifications.
requirements.implementation: No notification service or preferences exist.
requirements.decision: Define event set, channels, consent and reliability.

requirements.requirement: Provide leaderboards.
requirements.implementation: No leaderboard model/API/UI exists.
requirements.decision: Define ranking, anti-abuse and privacy.

requirements.requirement: Provide one-action creator market opening.
requirements.implementation: SDK and CreateMarketPanel cover exact allowance plus create; no real wallet/product flow exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: SDK unit and React SSR tests.
requirements.decision: Integrate templates, wallet, simulation and confirmation UX.

requirements.requirement: Provide one-action creator settlement with immediate payout visibility.
requirements.implementation: SDK/React expose resolve; no real wallet, live chain or payout product flow exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Local protocol and SSR tests only.
requirements.decision: Define terminal confirmation, irreversible warning and evidence attachment.

requirements.requirement: Provide an OBS overlay showing pool odds before close and C2C price after close.
requirements.implementation: No OBS application exists.
requirements.decision: Define auth, refresh, finality, stale state and platform ToS.

requirements.requirement: Provide share cards.
requirements.implementation: No share-card generator or deep-link flow exists.
requirements.decision: Define metadata safety and social-platform support.

requirements.requirement: Provide a creator revenue dashboard.
requirements.implementation: Fee events/API primitives exist; no creator revenue product exists.
requirements.decision: Define realized/accrued revenue and tax/export semantics.

requirements.requirement: Let unauthenticated users browse proposition, odds, settlement rules and labels; require login only when betting.
requirements.implementation: No flagship routing/auth experience exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze public/private data and session policy.

requirements.requirement: Create an embedded wallet from email, phone or social login with no separate registration form.
requirements.implementation: No identity or wallet onboarding integration exists.
requirements.decision: Select identity factors, recovery and account-linking rules.

requirements.requirement: Keep the wallet non-custodial, protect it with passkey and allow user key export.
requirements.implementation: No wallet runtime exists.
requirements.decision: Perform vendor threat model, recovery and export acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Keep the protocol funding-method agnostic and recognize only USDC; implement fiat paths only at frontend/service layer.
requirements.implementation: Contracts accept one configured USDC-like token and contain no fiat logic.
requirements.decision: Canonical USDC must be verified on the selected chain.

requirements.requirement: For crypto users, show wallet address/QR for USDC transfer and embed CCTP for cross-chain funding.
requirements.implementation: No deposit address/QR or CCTP integration exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze supported source chains and confirmation policy.

requirements.requirement: When funnel data justifies it, operate a local-payment-to-USDC treasury path with chargeback/fraud controls.
requirements.implementation: No acquiring, treasury or fraud system exists.
requirements.decision: Requires licensing, treasury risk and measured funnel trigger.

requirements.requirement: Provide guided deep links to licensed local exchanges as the low-engineering MVP fiat path.
requirements.implementation: No exchange guide/deep-link flow exists.
requirements.decision: Select countries/exchanges and validate withdrawal compatibility.

requirements.requirement: Provide multi-provider third-party on-ramp aggregation as a long-tail fallback.
requirements.implementation: No on-ramp provider integration exists.
requirements.decision: Select providers, KYC regions, fees and failure routing.

requirements.requirement: Use deposit-funnel data to sequence investment and trigger a first-deposit bonus on first arrival.
requirements.implementation: No funding analytics, bonus ledger or promotion policy exists.
requirements.decision: Define fraud-safe bonus terms and measurement.

requirements.requirement: Make buy, C2C exit, settlement, gasless claim and immediate reinvestment a low-friction end-to-end loop.
requirements.implementation: Protocol/SDK transaction surfaces exist; no real wallet, Paymaster or full-product E2E exists.
requirements.decision: Define and measure settlement-to-rebet acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Always allow users to send USDC to an arbitrary external address without platform approval or lockup.
requirements.implementation: Users control wallets in the target design, but no embedded-wallet withdrawal UI/runtime exists.
requirements.tests_evidence: Protocol cannot seize wallet USDC; no product proof.
requirements.decision: Provide safe-address and confirmation UX without custodial restriction.

requirements.requirement: Provide regional off-ramp and key-export fallback paths.
requirements.implementation: No off-ramp or embedded-wallet export integration exists.
requirements.decision: Validate coverage per launch market and independent recovery.

requirements.requirement: Measure registration, first deposit, first bet, reinvestment and withdrawal time, prioritizing deposit funnel and settlement-to-rebet interval.
requirements.implementation: No product analytics schema or provider evidence exists.
requirements.decision: Freeze event contract, consent, attribution and dashboards.

requirements.requirement: Do not block permissionless creator self-betting; disclose creator positions and manipulability instead.
requirements.implementation: Protocol does not block creator bets; disclosure UI/API is absent.
requirements.decision: Define creator/associated-address disclosure.

requirements.requirement: Detect associated accounts, Sybil activity and wash trading; emit signals into labels, creator credit and traffic ranking rather than protocol bans.
requirements.implementation: Indexer exposes raw data; no detection model, identity graph or scoring consumer exists.
requirements.decision: Define model, false-positive controls, privacy and appeal.

requirements.requirement: For post-close insider C2C risk, show prominent warnings, publish creator listings/fills and feed anomaly patterns into credit.
requirements.implementation: Listing/fill API exists; warnings, creator linkage and anomaly model are absent.
requirements.decision: Define attribution and warning thresholds.

requirements.requirement: Use emergency control only for contract-security incidents, not market intervention, and keep exits open.
requirements.implementation: EmergencyController permissions are bounded and listing fills may be paused as a new-buyer-risk path; cancel, terminal return, claim, refund and direct transfer stay open.
requirements.decision: Product decision frozen on 2026-09-02: fill pause is accepted only for contract-security incidents; publish and enforce that operating criterion.

requirements.requirement: Assess and mitigate streaming-platform ToS risk by market/platform allowlists, partnerships or non-cash modes where required.
requirements.implementation: No legal/ToS review or platform policy exists.
requirements.decision: Written sign-off is required per launch platform/region.

requirements.requirement: Track creator betrayal, deposit friction, C2C liquidity and insider-transfer risks as MVP acceptance metrics and residual risks.
requirements.implementation: Contract limits and raw events exist; product dashboards, calibrated thresholds and operating reviews do not.
requirements.decision: Set no-go thresholds for voids, complaints, deposits, fills and anomalous trades.

requirements.requirement: Do not issue a protocol token; keep governance in multisig and state decentralization claims narrowly.
requirements.implementation: No token exists and Safe/Timelock design is documented; real governance deployment and public claims are not verified.
requirements.decision: Freeze governance members and approved public claims.

requirements.requirement: Pay creator rake in USDC and let protocol earn creation fee, rake share and configurable C2C platform fee; never count slashed bond as revenue.
requirements.implementation: Factory, MarketVault, BondEscrow and FeeVault implement the separated revenue paths.
requirements.tests_evidence: Fee, bond and payout accounting tests.
requirements.decision: Freeze rates and treasury addresses.

requirements.requirement: Add mid-tier sports data cost only when objective sports categories launch; do not fund market making or oracle disputes.
requirements.implementation: No sports provider, MM or oracle-dispute spending exists.
requirements.decision: Provider selection follows Phase 2 validation.

requirements.requirement: Keep result disputes outside customer support; support only product and fund-transfer issues.
requirements.implementation: No support policy or operating system exists.
requirements.decision: Publish escalation and no-adjudication policy.

requirements.requirement: Make creator USDC rake and revenue visibility the primary creator incentive instead of token rewards.
requirements.implementation: Fee credits exist; revenue dashboard and creator growth loop are absent.
requirements.decision: Define displayed accrued/claimable/paid revenue.

requirements.requirement: Expand to objective categories such as sports using the same parimutuel plus C2C mechanism.
requirements.implementation: V1 contracts are generic; sports templates/data/product are absent.
requirements.decision: Trigger only after MVP trust, deposit and liquidity validation.

requirements.requirement: Add fixed-data-source API automatic settlement for objective markets.
requirements.implementation: No V1 API settlement mode.
requirements.decision: New market version and independent audit required.

requirements.requirement: Add buyer offers and bulk listing tools only if transaction data demonstrates the need.
requirements.implementation: Neither feature exists in V1.
requirements.tests_evidence: MVP fill-rate data does not yet exist.
requirements.decision: Define evidence trigger and keep any buyer-offer protocol independently reviewed.

requirements.requirement: Scale categories and deepen C2C experience with portfolio/combination positions.
requirements.implementation: Not present in V1.
requirements.decision: Requires validated liquidity and portfolio semantics.

requirements.requirement: Provide deeper market tools and an open market-data API.
requirements.implementation: Current API is a protocol read model, not the Phase 3 market-data product/SLA.
requirements.decision: Define public schema, latency, history and SLA.

requirements.requirement: If high-value markets demonstrate demand, evaluate optional arbitration as a separate creator-enabled market type.
requirements.implementation: V1 intentionally contains no arbitration path.
requirements.decision: Requires explicit demand trigger, new version and separate audit; must not alter V1 markets.
